data.summary: Two identifiable women perform an empty-hand wrist interaction in a coherent pool and separate afterward. Sword continuity fails: its initially downward blade swings across the body, then the sword-holding hand joins the interaction while a disconnected-looking hilt remains at the waist. The final composition clips the first woman at the left edge.

observations.text: The white-clad woman initially grips a downward blade. It swings across her waist before the black-clad woman reaches toward her raised empty hand; both faces remain distinct.

The raised empty hand redirects the approaching wrist. The other hand also joins the contact, while the sword hilt remains near the waist without a clear grip. Hand edges smear during contact; bubbles rise between their faces.

The women release contact, drift farther apart and face one another. The sword is no longer clearly retained in a separate downward grip, and the white-clad woman moves partly outside the left boundary. Hair, surface reflections and pool tiles remain coherent.
